reviews.title: This AIO Cooler Is a Monster
reviews.comment: After a lot of research and comparing different options, I finally decided to invest in the ROG Ryujin III 360 ARGB Extreme, and honestly, it’s one of the best hardware upgrades I’ve made to my PC. If you’re looking for a top-tier, powerful AIO cooler with insane aesthetics, this is it. Right out of the box, you can tell this is a premium product. The build quality is exceptional — everything feels solid, high-end, and well thought out. The 3.5-inch LCD screen is next-level. Not only is it super customizable, but also extremely useful for monitoring system temps, loads, and even displaying custom images or GIFs. It adds a futuristic, high-tech vibe to your setup. Performance-wise, the Ryujin III 360 is a beast. I’m running a high-end CPU, and this cooler keeps it running cool even under heavy workloads. The integrated pump fan and the Noctua radiator fans do an amazing job — whisper-quiet and super efficient, which is something I really appreciate during long gaming or work sessions. The integration with Armoury Crate is smooth too. From there, I customized both the screen and the ARGB lighting to match the rest of my ROG setup. It synced perfectly and gave me full control over the visual side of things. I 100% recommend this AIO to anyone who wants the best cooling performance with standout aesthetics. Yes, it’s a premium product and it’s not cheap — but you get what you pay for: stability, silence, power, and style. Perfect for gamers, streamers, and content creators who want nothing but the best. In short: • Insane thermal performance • Sleek, futuristic design • Quiet and powerful • Highly customizable • A must-have for enthusiasts and power users The ROG Ryujin III 360 ARGB Extreme is an absolute powerhouse and a centerpiece in any serious build.
reviews.author: Daniel Zamora

reviews.title: No regrets!
reviews.comment: After spending a couple of months researching and comparing all the different AIO coolers, I finally decided to invest in this ASUS ROG Ryujin III 360 ARGB Extreme AIO liquid cooler, I can honestly say it’s one of the best coolers available, the specs are amazing, as is the quality of the product. If you’re looking for a top-tier, powerful AIO cooler with insane aesthetics, this is it. Right out of the box, you can tell this is a premium product. The build quality is exceptional, everything feels solid, high-end, and well-thought-out. The large LCD screen is loaded with options and is awesome for those who want to know what their CPU and GPU stats are, you can also load custom images or GIFs and videos. As far as performance is concerned, the ASUS ROG Ryujin III 360 is on a level all its own. I’m running an AMD 9950X3D CPU on a ASUS ROG Strix X870E-E Gaming MB and this cooler not only keeps my CPU at very manageable temps, it's busy cooling my VRMs as well, which is a huge plus considering I have 96GB of RAM and a 7900XTX GPU also creating heat, my temps at idle are sitting around 42 C, and while gaming I have not gone over 70C, I can't ask for more than this. The integration with Armoury Crate so far has been smooth, too. Everything synced perfectly, giving me full control over the visual software side of things. I definitely recommend this AIO to anyone looking for the best cooling solution with excellent aesthetics. It’s a premium product, it’s not cheap — but we all know you get what you pay for: quality, stability, style, power, and options. The ASUS ROG Ryujin III 360 AIO CPU liquid cooler is perfect for gaming, content creating, streaming, and video editing. Note: If I have any problems, I will come back and add an edit to this review.

reviews.title: Cant stop starring
reviews.comment: The ROG Ryujin III 360 ARGB Extreme isn't just a cooler; it's a statement piece. The customizable LCD screen is mesmerizing, letting me showcase system stats or custom graphics. But the real magic is the cooling performance. My CPU has never run so cool and quiet, even under the most intense gaming sessions. Installation was surprisingly straightforward, and the build quality screams premium. Worth every penny for serious enthusiasts.
